RIGOR (reported, not fixed — MAJOR, and it falsifies the conjecture's central well-definedness claim). '## What remains open' item 1 asserts: 'The quadratic is preserved (since both sigma_i and sigma_i^{-1} satisfy the same relation): the quadratic (sigma_i - q)(sigma_i + q^{-1}) = 0 is invariant under P because (sigma_i^{-1} - q)(sigma_i^{-1} + q^{-1}) = 0 also holds (multiply the original by sigma_i^{-2}).' THIS IS FALSE, and the stated derivation produces the opposite conclusion. Checked symbolically in sympy: sigma satisfies x^2 - (q - q^{-1})x - 1 = 0 with eigenvalues {q, -q^{-1}}. Multiplying by sigma^{-2} — precisely the operation the parenthesis names — gives, for y = sigma^{-1}, y^2 + (q - q^{-1})y - 1 = 0, i.e. (y + q)(y - q^{-1}) = 0, eigenvalues {-q, q^{-1}}. The claimed (y - q)(y + q^{-1}) = 0 differs from the true one by 2y(1 - q^2)/q, which vanishes only at q = +-1. So sigma_i^{-1} does NOT satisfy the Hecke quadratic of H_n(q); the eigenvalue pair {q, -q^{-1}} maps to {q^{-1}, -q}, and those sets coincide only when q^2 = 1. CONSEQUENCE: the map sigma_i -> sigma_i^{-1} with q held fixed is not an algebra endomorphism of H_n(q), so 'P' as defined in the opening paragraph and in the displayed action is not well defined on the Hecke image — it is well defined only on the braid group B_n. This is exactly why the bar-involution must send q -> q^{-1} at the same time, a fact the block itself states two sections earlier ('bar ... acts as q -> q^{-1} AND sigma_i -> sigma_i^{-1} simultaneously'), so the block contradicts itself. The three-way CPT factorisation bar = P.C.T inherits the problem: neither C (flavour labels) nor T (word reversal) touches q, so no composite of the three as described can produce bar's q -> q^{-1}. Proposed: restate P as an involution of B_n (or of the diagram category) that does NOT descend to H_n(q) with q fixed, and re-derive what bar = P.C.T can mean — at minimum one of C or T must carry the q-inversion. Secondary: item 1 is filed under 'What remains open' while its body claims to settle it; whichever way the mathematics lands, the heading and the body disagree.
